title: Electrospun polyimide/organic montmorillonite composite nanofibrous membranes with enhanced mechanical properties and flame retardancy
sample_state: PI/M0, nominal 0% OMMT, initial thermally imidized nanofibrous membrane
washing_state: Initial prepared membrane; no process rinse or durability wash reported
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Methods: thermal stability of nanofibrous membranes; Table 2: thermal characteristics of PI/OMMT ESNF membranes.
source_material_form_LOI_raw: Methods call the cut strip a film sample (58 mm × 15 mm); LOI testing prose and Figure 7 caption identify PI/OMMT electrospun nanofibrous membranes.
treatment_chemistry: PMDA/ODA polyimide with no OMMT control.
treatment_method: PMDA and ODA, each 0.02 mol, were reacted in 50 mL DMF under N2 for 8 h. The pure-PAA example specifies ODA 4.0048 g, PMDA 4.3624 g, an ice bath at −2 °C and storage at −4 °C. For composite precursor suspensions, dry OMMT was sonicated in 50 mL DMF for 10 min before adding the same monomers. Electrospinning used 19 kV, a 20 cm gap, 0.45 mm spinneret inner diameter, rotating disc collector, 1.2 mL/h feed and 4.5 h collection. Membranes were dried overnight at 60 °C; thermal imidization used a 3 °C/min ramp to 120 °C with a 30 min hold, then the same ramp to 300 °C and a 120 min hold. No washing or durability laundering is reported.
TGA_specimen_preparation: Aliquot of the prepared electrospun membrane; mass, pan, gas flow, cutting or grinding not reported. Acquisition starts at room temperature, with no numeric start given.
LOI_instrument: Oxygen Index Meter ATSFAAR 20008600, Italy (source spelling)
LOI_locator: Published p.875 abstract and p.885 LOI testing: pure PI ESNF membrane 29.2; 3% OMMT membrane 30.4. Figure 7d not numerically estimated.
TG_locator: Published p.884, PDF p.10, Table 2: Td5%, Tdmax, dW/dTmax and WR. p.883 thermal-stability introduction explicitly identifies WR as residue at 800 °C.
conditions_locator: Published pp.877–878 precursor/membrane preparation; p.879 Characterizations for TG and measured LOI.
pairing_evidence: The source names PI/M0 as the prepared membrane with nominal 0% OMMT. Table 2 gives its TG row, and the LOI-testing prose explicitly identifies the pure PI membrane endpoint. Both are prepared electrospun membranes; no dense-film preparation is supplied, and the separate cotton heat-blocking demonstration is excluded.
source_access_method: Complete indexed original fourteen-page publisher PDF plus publisher article text for raw preparation units. Direct PDF retrieval returned403; no PDF hash or pixel-review claim.
limitations: Only PI/M0 and PI/M3 have explicit numerical LOI in the original abstract and LOI-testing prose. PI/M1, PI/M5 and PI/M7 appear in Figure 7d but exact numerical values were not retrieved; no graph reading or interpolation is used. The LOI method calls its strip a film sample, while preparation, microscopy, section heading, Figure 7 caption and results consistently identify the electrospun nonwoven nanofibrous membrane; no dense-film preparation or separate film formulation is described. The cotton bunch in Figure 7 is a separate heat-blocking demonstration, not the TG/LOI specimen. The raw standard is GB75454-1997 and is not silently corrected. The source nominal OMMT percentages use the stated monomer-mass approximation to PI mass, 8.3682 g; this denominator differs from the sum of the listed masses, and the later less-than-1-phr statement conflicts with the named 1–7% series. These recipe statements are retained without recalculating a final dry-composite loading. The source labels Tdmax as highest weight decomposition temperature without explicitly defining it as maximum-rate temperature; retain raw only. The original table labels dW/dTmax in %/°C; its scale has not been verified against figure pixels and it is not canonical. The 23 °C/65% RH and five-specimen statement occurs in the tensile paragraph; no TG/LOI replicate count or conditioning is assigned. TG mass, pan, gas flow and aliquot handling are absent. Complete fourteen-page indexed publisher original read; direct PDF bytes and figure pixels unavailable. The cloud browser displayed a security-verification page, which was not interacted with.

Figure 7d not numerically estimated.; Published pp.877–878 precursor/membrane preparation; p.879 Characterizations for TG and measured LOI.
source_OMMT_content_basis: mOMMT/mPI × 100%; source approximates mPI by sum of PMDA and ODA and explicitly reports 8.3682 g. No normalization or arithmetic repair.
source_max_weight_loss_rate_unit: %/°C, source Table 2 label; not canonical pending scale review
source_metric_holds: Tdmax maximum-rate identity and dW/dTmax scale retained raw only; graph-only LOIs for M1/M5/M7 held.
source_recipe_holds: Stated denominator 8.3682 g differs from listed 4.0048 g + 4.3624 g; later <1 phr conflicts with nominal 1–7% labels. Source nominal labels and applied OMMT masses preserved; no corrected loading.
source_numeric_evidence_description: TG from original Table 2 and measured LOI from explicit original prose, repeated in abstract. No figure-derived numerical values.
